base.kernel_policy: Debian-supported signed stock kernel; no custom kernel in the reference release

overlay_targets: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS amd64 and arm64, after ABI and integration tests
delivery.chromebook: Companion package inside an administrator-enabled and tested ChromeOS Linux environment
delivery.arm64_image_policy: Hardware-specific image certification; arm64 packages do not imply universal boot compatibility
delivery.live_session_vault: ephemeral-demo-only unless explicitly provisioned on encrypted persistent storage

installation.erase_policy: Interactive confirmation of exact target disk identity, capacity and affected partitions

encryption.key_derivation: Argon2id with installer-calibrated parameters recorded in the installation report
encryption.boot_unlock: initramfs unlocks root after bootloader loads the kernel; GRUB need not unlock root
encryption.recovery_key: Locally generated; displayed once for an explicitly chosen custodian; never in Git or telemetry

swap.disk_swap_when_enabled: Only inside an encrypted volume with explicit resource and resume validation

secure_boot.goal: Retain upstream signed shim, GRUB and kernel where supported; verify on each certified device

runtime.authority: Local Rust orchestrator and SQLCipher vault

updates.mechanism: APT with authenticated metadata and separately verified application/model manifests
updates.schema_migrations: Transactional with a consistent encrypted pre-migration recovery snapshot
updates.security_support_owner: Distribution maintainer for Commonstar packages; upstream support terms for upstream packages

recovery.os: Known-good recovery media, previous bootable kernel and reinstall procedure
recovery.application: Previous schema-compatible signed package or verified data restore
recovery.vault: One active writing device; consistent encrypted versioned snapshots to one selected backup destination
